name: Trinity Open-Source Self-Hosted AI Agent Platform
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted AI agent orchestration platform with Docker-based workspaces, agent schedules, approval gates, audit logs, and Claude Code/Codex/Gemini CLI runtime integrations; open-source core has no software license fee or vendor-hosted quota.
watch_out: Operator supplies Docker host, compute, storage, PostgreSQL and network infrastructure; model-provider API, agent runtime subscriptions, hosting and bandwidth may cost extra. Enterprise modules including organization SSO, advanced RBAC and compliance features require separate commercial licensing; do not treat them as included in the free open-source core.
